import pulp

# -------------------------
# Data
# -------------------------
size = [
    60, 55, 30, 63, 34, 35, 55, 30,
    53, 32, 37, 69, 30, 47, 70, 48
]  # cubic feet, package 1..16
capacity = 100          # cubic feet per truck
P = 16                  # number of packages
T_max = 16              # upper bound on trucks (one per package)

# -------------------------
# Model
# -------------------------
model = pulp.LpProblem("Truck_Packing", pulp.LpMinimize)

# Decision variables
# x[p][t] = 1 if package p is placed on truck t
x = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "x",
    (range(P), range(T_max)),
    lowBound=0,
    upBound=1,
    cat=pulp.LpBinary,
)

# y[t] = 1 if truck t is used
y = pulp.LpVariable.dicts(
    "y",
    range(T_max),
    lowBound=0,
    upBound=1,
    cat=pulp.LpBinary,
)

# -------------------------
# Objective: minimize number of trucks used
# -------------------------
model += pulp.lpSum(y[t] for t in range(T_max)), "R0_Minimize_Trucks"

# -------------------------
# Requirements as constraints
# -------------------------

# R1: each package assigned to exactly one truck
for p in range(P):
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(x[p][t] for t in range(T_max)) == 1,
        f"R1_pkg_{p+1}",
    )

# R2: capacity of each truck cannot be exceeded
for t in range(T_max):
    model += (
        pulp.lpSum(size[p] * x[p][t] for p in range(P))
        <= capacity * y[t],
        f"R2_capacity_{t+1}",
    )

# R3: a truck is used if at least one package is assigned to it
for p in range(P):
    for t in range(T_max):
        model += (
            x[p][t] <= y[t],
            f"R3_link_{p+1}_{t+1}",
        )

# R4: all decision variables are binary (explicit bounds)
for p in range(P):
    for t in range(T_max):
        model += (
            x[p][t] <= 1,
            f"R4_x_ub_{p+1}_{t+1}",
        )
        model += (
            x[p][t] >= 0,
            f"R4_x_lb_{p+1}_{t+1}",
        )
for t in range(T_max):
    model += (
        y[t] <= 1,
        f"R4_y_ub_{t+1}",
    )
    model += (
        y[t] >= 0,
        f"R4_y_lb_{t+1}",
    )

# -------------------------
# Solve
# -------------------------
solver = pulp.HiGHS(msg=False, timeLimit=120)
model.solve(solver)

# -------------------------
# Output results
# -------------------------
print("Status:", pulp.LpStatus[model.status])
trucks_used = sum(int(pulp.value(y[t])) for t in range(T_max))
print("Number of trucks used:", trucks_used)

for t in range(T_max):
    if pulp.value(y[t]) > 0.5:
        assigned = [
            p + 1
            for p in range(P)
            if pulp.value(x[p][t]) > 0.5
        ]
        total_vol = sum(size[p - 1] for p in assigned)
        print(f"Truck {t+1} (used): packages {assigned}, total volume {total_vol} cu ft")
